requested_by: 동동 (2026-11-17): 일봉으로 길게 보고 전저점에 가까워지면 롱, 전저점을 뚫고 내려가면 조금씩 물타기로 평단 낮춤. 숏은 전고점에서 같은 방식
reading: Daily bars. Reference line = prior N-day extreme (event day excluded). First tranche when close is within a=3% of the line or beyond it; each further tranche when a later daily close is below (long) the line by s*k, k=1..K. Short is the exact mirror at the prior N-day high.

data.source: project upload data/alts_2021_2026_binance_um_15m_funding.zip (17 USDT-M alts: ADA AVAX BCH BNB DOGE HYPE LINK LTC NEAR SOL SUI TRX UNI XLM XMR XRP ZEC); daily bars aggregated from 15m UTC; data.binance.vision blocked in this environment so the top-50 point-in-time universe of ADR 0035 is NOT used
data.btc_eth: not in the upload; not used

fixed.tranche_size: W/(K+1), W=0.05 of constant capital 1 per symbol (same max exposure for every K)
fixed.fills: signal on daily close, fill at next day open
fixed.stop_target: exit signal when close <= L0*(1-s*(K+1)) (short mirror) OR close >= avg_price*1.10 (short: <= avg*0.90) OR 60 days held; fill next open
fixed.target_time_only: no stop: exit signal only on close >= avg*1.10 (short mirror) or 60 days held; fill next open
fixed.liquidation: if the day's low (short: high) reaches avg*(1-1/5+mmr) the cycle is liquidated that day and loses its full posted margin (notional/5); gap beyond liquidation also loses the margin only (isolated, no negative balance)
fixed.funding: actually settled funding rates, charged on held notional per day
fixed.cost: measured alt cost PE-ed757f47 (estimate_v3_alts.json) per tranche fill and per exit; volume-scaled calibration (ADR 0041), x2, assumed public v1 and cost0 reported; 26.6bp round trip reference

grid.note: Long-only and short-only decompositions are reported, not extra trials. Any later change of a, W, tp, timeout, leverage, universe is a new prereg and new trials.

judgement_dev_only.a: S1 annualised Sharpe (measured cost, constant capital 1) > expected max under N=24 (and cumulative N)
judgement_dev_only.g_tail: S1 and S2 intraday-envelope max drawdown <= 0.20 of capital AND liquidated cycles <= 5% of cycles
judgement_dev_only.h_scale_in_control: report (not gate): S1 and S2 Sharpe of K>0 vs K=0 with same N, s, exit_mode

tail_report: intraday envelope max drawdown (adverse extreme of every open position the same day)
worst cycle net return on cycle notional
